purpose: Confirm whether completed volume candles add held-out predictive value to the existing native-venue network model on dates not used in the October exploration.
reference_features: Existing own-venue and market-proxy shock history, elapsed time and other-venue shock history, extended to the same eight venues.
evaluation_rows: Identical paired rows satisfying existing quote/history/label coverage and all eight completed same-stock venue volume states. No time-candle mask.
missing_venue_or_date_policy: No venue or intended date is silently dropped. Report retention by feed/day. Inadequate full intended holdout coverage is explicit insufficient evidence.
primary_metric: Pooled paired log loss: sum(reference loss minus volume loss) divided by sum(reference loss). Positive means improvement.
secondary_metric: Paired pooled Brier score and positive-day/stock/venue counts.

uncertainty.unit: whole date, all stocks and venues together

support_rule: At least all 20 intended held-out sessions complete and the lower 95% five-session moving-block log-loss gain interval above zero. Report the actual effect size and both intervals, including only about four week-length blocks of information.
interpretation: Predictive association only. No maker identities, causal venue influence, execution profitability or full-day generalization is established.
